scope: Frozen word-copy XZ plus 48-slot lazy private data cache and bounded metadata. Four identical native campaigns are explicitly reused; all user observations are new. Native optimized normal/relaxed references carry the identical edited XZ algorithm, while predecessor references remain explicitly labeled. Separate matrices, equal campaign weight, three campaign means per cell. Pointwise Student-t 95% CIs on campaign mean log paired ratios. Secondary bootstrap resamples campaigns and paired blocks. Absolute times are means of campaign medians, not operands of paired ratios.
